module: Registry of vehicle damage states, organized by group then by name (e.g. group 'energyStorage', tank name). Each change is queued and sent to the UI every 1/3 s via the `DamageData` hook, with optional callbacks for other modules. A modder calls setDamage to report a failure and getDamage to read it.
usage:
damageTracker.setDamage("engine", "overheat", true, true)   -- also notifies the UI
local broken = damageTracker.getDamage("engine", "overheat")
damageTracker.setDamageTemporary("engine", "overheat", true, false, 5)
notes: The UI message uses the translation key `vehicle.<group>.<name>.<value>` and is only sent to seated players (guihooks.messageForSeatedPlayers).
setDamage does nothing if the value is unchanged. It enables the updateGFXDirty loop, which resets to nop as soon as there is nothing left to send or expire.
damageData is sent in full to the DamageData hook; callbacks receive (damageData, damageDataDelta) where damageDataDelta only contains the changes since the last send.
getDamage returns false (not nil) for an unknown pair or a nil/false value.
init also clears the callback list (registerDamageUpdateCallback), reset does not clear it.

init.desc: Called at vehicle creation: clears data, deltas, callbacks and timeouts.

reset.desc: Called at reset: clears data, deltas and timeouts (keeps the callbacks).

updateGFX.desc: Is nop at rest; becomes updateGFXDirty when a damage changes or must expire. Periodically sends DamageData and counts down temporary damages. Called every frame by the main loop.

setDamage.desc: Sets the damage state of a group/name pair (cancels any ongoing timeout on this pair).

notifyUI.desc: If true, displays an on-screen message.

setDamageTemporary.desc: Like setDamage but schedules a return to timeoutValue after timeout seconds.

notifyUI.desc: Notify the UI on immediate application.

getDamage.desc: Reads the damage state of a group/name pair.

returns.desc: The value, or false if absent.

sendNow.desc: Forces the sending of the DamageData hook and callbacks on the next frame (resets the timer to 0).

willSend.desc: Indicates whether a send has just been armed (timer at its full value) and a first player is seated.

returns.desc: true if the send is imminent.

registerDamageUpdateCallback.desc: Adds a callback called on each DamageData send with (damageData, damageDataDelta). Ignored if nil.
